'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2023 Crimean Bridge explosion]]
***A couple are killed and their daughter is injured by [[explosion]]s at the [[Crimean Bridge]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/traffic-stopped-crimean-bridge-due-emergency-russian-backed-governor-2023-07-17/ (Reuters)] [https://www.theguardian.com/world/live/2023/jul/17/russia-ukraine-war-live-crimean-bridge-emergency-traffic-stops-explosion (''The Guardian'')]
**[[Black Sea Grain Initiative]]
***The agreement to allow safe passage of grain exports from [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] ports, in effect since July 2022, expires following [[Russia]]'s refusal to renew the deal. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/black-sea-grain-deal-expire-monday-if-russia-quits-2023-07-17/ (Reuters)]
*[[Afghan conflict]]
**Three children are killed and two others are injured when a [[mortar (weapon)|mortar]] [[warhead]] explodes in [[Dara-i Sufi Payin District]], [[Samangan Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.khaama.com/mine-explosion-kills-3-injures-2-in-afghanistans-samangan/ (Khaama Press)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Pacific typhoon season]]
**[[Monsoon]] rains aggravated by [[Tropical Storm Talim (2023)|Tropical Storm Talim]] have affected the northern [[Philippines]], killing a person during a [[landslide]] in [[Rizal (province)|Rizal]]. Nine crew members of a fishing vessel who went missing off [[Camarines Norte]] are rescued off [[Camarines Sur]]. [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2023/07/17/2281708/ndrrmc-1-dead-26k-affected-heavy-rain-dodong-habagat (''The Philippine Star'')] [https://tonite.abante.com.ph/2023/07/17/9-crew-sa-missing-bangka-natagpuan-na/ (''Abante Tonite'')]
*[[2023 Greece wildfires]]
**Two [[wildfire]]s near the [[Greece|Greek]] [[seaside town]]s of [[Lagonisi]], [[East Attica]], and [[Loutraki]], [[Corinthia]], cause significant [[property damage]] and prompt the [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] of thousands. The [[Athens urban area]] and most of [[southern Greece]] are on the second highest level of wildfire alert. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/wildfires-threaten-seaside-homes-greek-capital-101337335 (AP via ABC News)]
*Fifteen people are killed, six others are injured and thirteen more are missing during [[landslide]]s caused by heavy [[rain]]s in [[Quetame]], [[Colombia]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/colombia-landslide-kills-15-blocks-major-highway/a-66280072 (DW)]
*Thirteen people are killed and five others are injured when a building collapses in [[Cairo]], [[Egypt]]. [https://english.ahram.org.eg/NewsContent/1/1235/504906/Egypt/Urban--Transport/-people-die-in-building-collapse-in-Cairo.aspx (''Al-Ahram'')]
*Five people are killed and seven others are injured when a [[Cessna 208 Caravan|Cessna 208]] aircraft [[2023 Chrcynno Cessna 208 crash|crashes]] into a [[hangar]] at an [[aerodrome]] in the village of [[Chrcynno]], [[Poland]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/world-news/small-plane-crashes-in-poland-5-killed-minister-4216881 (AFP via NDTV)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[World Health Organization]] reports that the [[avian influenza]] is responsible for killing dozens of cats across 13 [[regions of Poland]], marking the first instance of the virus affecting a large number of [[Felinae|felines]] over an extensive area. [https://globalnews.ca/news/9836502/cat-deaths-bird-flu-poland/ (Global News)]

**[[Israel]] recognizes [[Morocco]]'s sovereignty over [[Western Sahara]]. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/article-750396 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Shakahola Forest incident]]
**The number of people who died in [[Kenya]] after following a [[pastor]] who ordered them to [[Fasting in religion|fast to death]] in order to meet [[Jesus]] increases to 403 as the bodies of twelve more people are [[exhume]]d. [https://apnews.com/article/kenya-cult-deaths-mackenzie-grave-doomsday-2f296b2fa239097d6397179a1a37338d (AP)]
*A [[Judiciary of Kenya#The Magistrate Court|Kenyan magistrate court]] [[Acquittal|acquits]] former [[Kenyans in the United Kingdom|British-based]] [[Evangelicalism|evangelist]] [[Gilbert Deya]], who claimed to aid [[infertile]] couples [[Gilbert Deya#'Miracle Babies' & child trafficking|conceive through prayer]], due to insufficient prosecution evidence connecting Deya to the [[Trafficking of children|trafficking of five children]] between 1999 and 2004. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/07/18/world/americas-emea/kenyan-court-acquits-miracle-baby-pastor/1901147 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
